intro.text: A Ghostblood operative working from a hideout near an Alethi warcamp.
A Thaylen Ghostblood operative known as Stolen Purse, who works under cover as a trader.

items.text: Aika and her fellow operative Jezinor were due at a Ghostblood hideout near an Alethi warcamp, and the operatives guarding it wanted bystanders cleared away before they arrived.

She attended a Ghostblood meeting with Mraize, Iyatil and others of her cell, where Mraize showed off new weapons, including a hand ballista, and discussed intelligence about Highprince Dalinar Kholin.

personality.text: Within her organisation she goes by the nickname Stolen Purse, one of several used in her cell. She talks casually with her superiors, calling Mraize 'love'.
